long_biography.plain_text:
The LNM Institute of Information Technology in Jaipur gave steel industrialist Lakshmi Niwas Mittal’s philanthropy a permanent educational institution in his native Rajasthan. Founded with his wife Usha and the state government, it was designed to expand technology education. Their support for child health has also reached Great Ormond Street Hospital, UNICEF and Oxford’s Jenner Institute.

Mittal’s industrial work began far from Rajasthan. After studying commerce in Kolkata and working in his family’s steel business, he established an Indonesian mill in 1976 with financial backing from his father. A later division of the family interests left him with the international arm, which he transformed through cross-border acquisitions into the steel group now called ArcelorMittal.
